_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The mobile drawer follows the finger and cancels safely on a second finger or touchcancel. The phone's screen is 393x851. The page has synthetic touch gestures, run with eval: "window.__drawerSwipe(selector, x1, y1, x2, y2)" puts one finger down at viewport point x1,y1 on the first element matching selector, moves it to x2,y2 and lifts it; "window.__drawerDrag(selector, points, ending, secondFinger, modalAtEnd)" puts a finger down at the first [x, y] of points and moves it through the rest (with a second finger beside it when secondFinger is true), then ends with ending ("touchend" or "touchcancel"); when modalAtEnd is true a modal (".command-palette-overlay" with aria-modal) appears just before the release and goes after it. __drawerDrag returns the computed styles ({className, transform, translate, opacity}) of every ".drawer, .backdrop, .toc-drawer, .toc-drawer-scrim" element just before the release, and keeps them in window.__drawerDragStyles. Run each gesture with a single eval, without expect; wait for its target to exist first. "Open" means the drawer (".drawer") has the class "open"; "closed" that it does not. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list to one conversation, "first", and cut off its live update stream; there is nothing to set up or check about that. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Drag ".main-content" through [[180,300],[260,302],[370,304]] with "touchend". 3. Mid-gesture the drawer had moved and its scrim was partly opaque: eval (() => { const s = window.__drawerDragStyles; const drawer = s.find(x => x.className.includes('drawer')); const scrim = s.find(x => x.className.includes('backdrop')); return !!drawer && !!scrim && drawer.transform !== 'matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)' && Number(scrim.opacity) > 0 && Number(scrim.opacity) < 1; })() must be true. 4. The drawer should be open. 5. Drag ".backdrop" through [[350,300],[250,302]] with "touchend" and a second finger. 6. The drawer is still open. 7. Swipe ".backdrop" from 350,300 to 150,304. 8. The drawer should be closed. 9. Drag ".main-content" through [[180,300],[220,302]] ending with "touchcancel". 10. The drawer is closed.
